rows.label: tlk70000075_02_msg001
rows.name:
Once we set out on a campaign like
this, there's no telling when we'll be
able to return home.

rows.label: tlk70000075_02_msg002
rows.name:
So soldiers usually aren't thrilled
to be assigned such missions. But
Meknes from my squad is different.

rows.label: tlk70000075_02_msg003
rows.name:
You might call it innocent enthusiasm:
a pure desire to help His Majesty,
stronger than anyone else's.

rows.label: tlk70000075_02_msg004
rows.name:
Though he hasn't shown any standout
skill, I see promise in him. He'll
surely prove himself on this mission.
